description: "A Selection from the Lyrical Poems of Robert Herrick" by Robert Herrick is a curated anthology of lyrical poetry crafted during the 17th century.
longDescription: This collection highlights Herrick's diverse themes, most notably his reflections on nature, love, and rural life, evoking a pastoral charm that resonates with readers.

authorInfo.bio: Robert Herrick (1591–1674) wrote A Selection from the Lyrical Poems of Robert Herrick. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
